title: YouTube AdFree
appDescription: YouTube AdFree built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3 with GTV patches that harden Home/feed ad filtering against fresh-launch timing, wrapped renderer shapes, continuations, and known masthead/promotion renderer variants; extend the existing Remove Shorts option across Home, Search, subscriptions, channel/browse shelves, pagination, and continuation responses; suppress inline playback promotion surfaces that can present QR-code and Shop overlays; and harden the inherited playback JSON hook so unrelated JSON.stringify calls retain native behavior and avoid unnecessary deep cloning.
